title: PEOPLE LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps headline with a short detail only when needed. The lines about people were still sentences: Order: Grit, on me., Revived by Kite., Grit pulls you up. That is what you paid for., The slab eats it. Get behind him., Kite is joining the raid., Kite is out of this raid (extracted). and the Survivor, Peddler and pillager replies. They now read GRIT FOLLOWS YOU, KITE REVIVED YOU, GRIT REVIVED YOU, THE BULWARK BLOCKED IT with Get behind it., KITE IS JOINING THE RAID, KITE EXTRACTED, HE NEEDS AMMUNITION, NO DEAL, THE PEDDLER BOLTS, NAME TRUSTED YOU, NAME WILL REMEMBER THAT and KITE IS SEARCHING. Every seat gate on gifts, aid and revives is unchanged.
now: Hire orders, revives, teammates joining and leaving, and the Survivor, Peddler and pillager replies read as caps callouts.
